limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
No synthesis or board verification performed.
Unknown input behavior is unspecified by the problem and was not assigned an oracle.
interface_cycle_contract: Original ports preserved; combinational outputs, no clocks, reset, or added latency.
numeric_width_decisions: Sum wraps to 8 bits; overflow detects equal operand signs and a differing result sign. Test oracle uses integer signed addition and range [-128,127].
static_review: Single continuous driver per output; explicit port widths; no state or inferred latches.
